notes.title: Update #14 - Workshop Season!
notes.content: [h2]Hello Dismounters![/h2][p][/p][p]It's time to get serious with Steam Workshop. A [b]HUGE[/b] tip of the hat to everyone who has created custom levels already, and now we want to highlight how it's done.[/p][p][b][i]The goal is for Turbo Dismount 2 to be a game where levels and gameplay can evolve infinitely[/i][/b]. The tools for custom levels are not just about roads, traps, and NPC vehicles, they are essentially a visual programming tool that makes it possible to create anything from new game modes to new traps, new mechanisms, new scoring logic... we have barely scratched the surface of their potential.[/p][p][b][i]All levels in the game have been built with the same tools[/i]. [/b]Racing levels, Dismount levels, the glove power-up, catapults, drifting and so on are logic built with the same tools that are available for Workshop.[/p][p][b][i]We want to help you make the best levels possible.[/i][/b] The primary place for any support is on the Workshop Discussions forum, but don't hesitate to ping us on Bluesky & X/Twitter as well. There is a learning curve, but examples and documentation are going to improve as we make our way through Early Access.[/p][p][/p][p]This is also an update with a bunch of fixes and improvements to levels, graphics settings, and performance.[/p][p][/p][h2]Levels[/h2][list][*][p]New level: [b]Dismount Derby[/b]! (But you'll need to grab it from the Workshop!)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138802/ca3ffe0c569def0e6a97730b430734bbaf044f4b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138802/378e6d714d6cea13b5d9382485eead18c5ba70a9.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Scoring logic tweaks on: Barrel Jump, Chef's Kiss, Constructive Feedback, Glove Plaza, Bruise Control, Underbash, Punch 'em High, Slam Dunk, Stair Chase, Out of Office, Murder Moon, Tropic Cruise, Owtobahn[/p][/*][*][p]Big Air Compo scoring now based on jump distance! [b]Leaderboards reset![/b][/p][/*][*][p]Parkade Drift scoring now based on drifting! [b]Leaderboardsd reset![/b][/p][/*][/list][h2][/h2][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p][b]UI:[/b] Workshop tab re-worked! Clearer cards for level creators, access to Workshop through a card in the menu.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138802/d5e90f2c7723577589de0f564dedcf30dbc65472.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]UI:[/b] Clearer "Upload to Workshop" functionality[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI:[/b] Incorrect selection shown in some level tabs[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI:[/b] Some users may have missed unwrapping some levels in the level selection menu. That is now fixed, but some may now have to unwrap levels again. Apologies![/p][/*][*][p][b]UI, Graphics:[/b] Custom graphics settings added! Now possible to toggle bloom, depth of field, screen space reflections, and vignette[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics: [/b]Dust and smoke VFX visuals tweaked[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics:[/b] Dither see-through effect now always happens in correct location[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics:[/b] Contact particle improvements[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance:[/b] Memory leak fixes[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance:[/b] Light mast lights optimized[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance:[/b] The game now properly throttles when not in focus[/p][/*][*][p][b]AI:[/b] NPC vehicles with reduced stupidity, now improved reactions to player proximity[/p][/*][*][p]Music now properly resumes if video capture is cancelled[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vehicles:[/b] Besserwisser now has a stronger reaction to boost pads[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update #13 - Racing Season!

notes.title: Update #10 - Engine Upgrade & Space Heroics!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Dismounters![/h2][p]
Whew, migrating to a newer game engine never goes smoothly, but here we are!
Turbo Dismount 2 is now running on top of Unity 6, and we have some scars, bruises, and performance improvements to show for it.

Please report any glitches and misbehavings to the forums, and we'll take a hammer to them.

[/p][h2]Vehicles[/h2][list][*][p]New vehicle: [b]Quad-Fin Fighter[/b]! The favourite of all galactic heroes!

notes.content:
[h2]Hello Dismounters![/h2][p]
Back with a smash!
Race levels now feature time-based leaderboards, now it's a competition about speed!

Speaking of speed, NPC vehicles are now stupid, dangerous, and capable of higher velocities than before.

Performance has been improved, stutters have been reduced, and levels with NPCs see notable gains.

notes.title: Update #8
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Dismounters![/h2][p]
We're back again! Score calculation is going to get more love in the coming updates, but we start here. The basic scoring is now re-balanced to take multiple characters better into account. More damage events are now recognized and displayed with the damage icons on the side of the screen.

[b][u]NOTE: A leaderboard reset is approaching with the coming updates![/u][/b]

Levels are going to have multiple score types from record times to damage points, so the current system is not going to remain once all the good stuff is in place.

notes.title: Update #5
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Dismounters![/h2]

There are now [b]over 50 Workshop Levels[/b]! That is absolutely awesome!
This update greatly expands on Workshop level features from music to forces to physics joints!
(Enjoy what physics joints can do in Axe to Grind...)

[h2]Levels[/h2]
[list]
[*]New level: [b]Axe to Grind[/b]!
[*]New level: [b]Thread the Needle[/b]!
[/list]

[h2]Workshop Level Editor Package[/h2]
[list]
[*]Support added for [b]more joint types[/b] (Hinge, Spring, Configurable and Spline Joints), you can do amazing things in Workshop levels with these!
[*]PawnApplyForce / PawnApplyTorque nodes can now be used on player ragdolls and vehicles. Yes, you can now [b]affect ragdolls and player vehicles with forces[/b] in node logic!
[*]Fixed PawnApplyForce local space mode
[*]New node: SetMusic, [b]level creators can choose what music plays and when[/b]
[*][i]None[/i] music option added to Level Settings, select this when music is controlled by SetMusic node
[*]SnappyBlock fixes (magnet snap radii, additional safety-checks)
[*]Fixed support for custom PillarSpawners
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Running the game on the Steam Deck now defaults to [b][i]Handheld[/i] quality level[/b]
[*]Camera mode and target persist between dismounts
[*]Camera target outline flashes briefly when cycling targets
[*]Game hang from a specific vehicle/camera combination fixed
[*]Game controller rumble fixes
[*]The Title Screen finally plays The Dismount Theme Song!
[*]Constructive Feedback level start position fix
[*]Crush Rush HUD fix
[*]Increased durability of Cricket's, Ricky-Tick's, and LeDorean's engines
[/list]

notes.title: Update #4
notes.content:
Hello Dismounters!

Keep sending your feedback, Turbo Dismount 2 will only improve!
In this update, we focus on the game cameras and how the game communicates its controls. Our goal is to make the game easily accessible to new players, and existing players may also note a few features that have not been well communicated.

Level creators need to be aware of the road spline improvement in this update!

[list]
[*]New camera logic: TAB and controller SHOULDER BUMPERS cycle the active camera target. "Natural 1st person" setting is removed, and now all vehicles have a dedicated Dashcam view, and each passenger has their own views. You can drive the vehicle from any passenger's viewpoint!
[*]New level: Pendulum Passage!
[*]New on-screen control help (can be disabled in Settings)
[*]New loading screen tips and messages
[*]Option to disable the slomo waltz
[*]Camera shake improvements
[*]UI fixes
[*]Workshop: Level Editor Package: New modular power-up logic group and example, new spline-animated NPCs for scene backgrounds, ramp tile collider fix
[*]Workshop: Level Editor Package: Road generation improved. NOTE!!! Existing Workshop levels will need re-routing road segments when updated! Apologies for the inconvenience!
[*]New High Score -sound effect tuned
[*]Smooth Cruiser character pose fixes
[*]Score counter legibility improved
[/list]

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
Our journey through Early Access continues!

All feedback is welcome, and below is a list of things addressed and improved in this update.
This update focuses on logic nodes for Workshop levels, with new examples and level templates.

[list]

[*]Maximus durability improved
[*]Workshop: Level Editor Package updated with new template levels and logic examples
[*]Workshop: New Logic Prefabs listing button on SX Toolbox

[*]Workshop: Level export validation improved
[*]Workshop: New settings in SX Toolbox

[*]Par One level tuning
[/list]

Thank you for an awesome first week of Early Access!
We read all feedback, and below is a list of things addressed and improved in this update.
The number of levels on Workshop is [i]amazing[/i], and we want to improve the level tools so that even more versatile gameplay can be created.

[list]

[*]Vehicles reversing at Dismount start fixes

[*]Ring of Fire now with some springiness
[*]Fast and Curious level time limit increased
[*]Natural First Person Camera enabled by default
[*]Boss Throne improvements: rocking, swiveling, handbrake
[*]User music support for unexpectedly large music libraries
[*]Unintentional debug visuals disabled

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Thank you everyone who joined us on the launch day!
Let's kick off the journey of Dismount improvement by fixing some of the little things that have come up.

Version 0.2.37
[list]
[*]Pink Lightning honk sound fixed (caused issues in replay)
[*]UI fix for entering the Main Menu in Replay mode
[*]Workshop browser no longer conflicts with game controls
[*]Webcam device selection using the mouse pointer fixed
[*]Minor UI polish
[/list]

notes.title: Turbo Dismount 2 Early Access!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome![/h1]

It's been over six years, but now we're really back. [b]Turbo Dismount 2[/b] begins its Early Access phase, and we can't wait for your feedback!

Our humble goal is to make Turbo Dismount 2 a sandbox that allows the community to create new gameplay and share awesome videos about it.

Join us on the discussion forums!
